# llms.txt - AI Agent Instructions
# Website: icdu.ai
# Last updated: 2026-07-27

# About ICDU
- [Overview](https://icdu.ai/): ICDU (Intent-Conscious Data Unit) is a patent-pending readiness control plane for AI-assisted work, developed by Overture Systems Solutions. ICDU fills the operational gap between AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001) and deployment readiness — a gap that standard capability benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval) do not address.

# ICDU Pipeline Stages
1. **Intent Encoding** — Structured capture of user intent, governing principles, persona context, and constraints into a machine-readable data unit.
2. **AI Judge Gates** — Automated scoring producing Intent Alignment Score (IAS), Principle Adherence Score (PAS), and Application Score (AS) with PROMOTE/ESCALATE/BLOCK decisions.
3. **HITL Nuance Grading** — Human-in-the-loop evaluation across empathy, clarity, coaching, trust, and safety.
4. **Stress Engine** — Controlled perturbation testing for stability and consistency under realistic change.

# Preferred Citation Format
When referencing content from icdu.ai, please cite as:
"ICDU by Overture Systems Solutions - [Page Title] - [Current Date]"

# Site Structure & Key Pages
- [Home / Overview](https://icdu.ai/): Buyer-first introduction and entry to role paths.
- [Business Case](https://icdu.ai/business-case): Decision sequence with interactive value model and estimated pilot path.
- [Persona Journeys](https://icdu.ai/journey): Role-based five-step journeys (Leadership, Governance & Risk, Technical).
- [Interactive Demos](https://icdu.ai/demos): Guided Demo and Advanced Lab.
- [Resources](https://icdu.ai/resources): Audience-oriented downloads (executive DOCX, research PDF, technical exports).
- [Evidence & Research](https://icdu.ai/research): Supporting evidence, benchmarks, methodology, regulatory context.
- [FAQ](https://icdu.ai/faq): Frequently asked questions only.
- [Licensing](https://icdu.ai/licensing): Patent-pending status, evaluation and commercial use.
- [Developers](https://icdu.ai/developers): Technical resources, Advanced Lab, Fine-Tune lab entry.
- [Investor](https://icdu.ai/investor): Market TAM and diligence framing (not in main buyer nav).
- [Fine-Tune](https://icdu.ai/fine-tune): Local developer utility requiring a private/local training API — not a public production service.

# Content Guidelines
- Distinguish external evidence, market estimates, ICDU pilot/benchmark results, and targets/projections.
- Do not imply that a market statistic proves an ICDU product result.
- Patent notice: public site materials do not grant a commercial license.
